phases.title: Keep the fleet in sync
phases.goal: Every project runs the same, current method.
phases.deliverable: No drift between this source of record and any project's installed copies.

phases.title: Grow the method
phases.goal: Capture what's actually practiced but not yet written down.
phases.deliverable: Conventions and skills that match how work really happens.

tasks.title: Write to the owner in plain language, and end every response with clearly marked options
tasks.note: Owner feedback 2026-07-28: 'I need the instructions and requests you ask me to be more straightforward. I'm often confused about your responses and next steps.' Added to conventions/house-rules.md under Interaction and to the standing-preferences snippet that install.sh --prefs writes. Covers: lead with the ask; spell out every abbreviation every message; no internal nicknames from analysis; one ask per message; say where to click and what changes; short sentences; say plainly when nothing is needed. Repo-internal precision is unaffected - the rule governs what is said to the owner. Extended same day at the owner's request: every response ends with a numbered 'Your options' section (or 'Nothing for you to do'), recommended option marked, do-nothing option included when real, written out even when a clickable menu is also shown; never end with an open-ended 'let me know what you think'.

tasks.title: Every project carries strategy + business plan + task plan, cross-linked in HTML
tasks.note: Owner rule 2026-07-28. render_docs.py and build_dashboard.py both emit a nav strip linking docs/STRATEGY.html, docs/BUSINESS-PLAN.html and dashboard/index.html, marking the current page and skipping targets that do not exist (no dead links). Nav is order-independent: a render run counts its own planned outputs, so cross-links do not depend on which file renders first (bug found and fixed in test). Rule written into house-rules.md, plan-track SKILL.md and project-init step 4.

tasks.title: The manual pushes to nobody — projects pull and install themselves
tasks.note: Owner correction 2026-07-28: a dev-ops session had opened PRs into SpecBuildr (#56) and NewCoEndotest (#15) — one repo modifying two it does not own, the largest version of the ownership problem the day had already hit twice. Rule + decision record added; the claim-signal PRs (SpecBuildr #53, NewCo #14) were merged as a live bug fix; the HTML-twin PRs (#56, #15) were CLOSED unmerged so each project pulls the rule itself. Carve-out added: the cross-project night shift DOES open a draft PR per repo, because it executes the project's own approved tasks rather than importing a rule the project did not choose. Projects adopt via ./install.sh --repo <path> in their own session.

tasks.title: Every markdown plan or to-do list gets a generated HTML twin
tasks.note: Owner rule 2026-07-28: plans and checklists must be readable without a markdown viewer. Added plan-track/assets/render_docs.py (dependency-free, self-contained output: inline CSS, no external assets, no JS, light/dark aware; renders task checkboxes, nested lists, tables, code, blockquotes; rejects javascript:/data: hrefs) plus --check staleness mode. Rule written into conventions/house-rules.md, plan-track SKILL.md, and project-init step 4. Applies to PLAN/BACKLOG/ROADMAP/OWNER-TASKS/launch plans/content plans.

tasks.title: Remove the branch-ahead claim test from the protocol (squash merges poison it)
tasks.note: Found after PR #52: all 13 SpecBuildr claude/* branches read as ahead of main, including one merged 4 minutes earlier - squash merging means branch commits never become ancestors, so branch-ahead is a permanent false claim that grows nightly. Rule now: claimed = status in-progress OR an open PR touches the files. Fixed in skills/night-shift/SKILL.md + conventions/house-rules.md + decision record; trickles to both project CLAUDE.mds, their installed skill copies, and the night-shift Routine prompt.

tasks.justification: Moves projects-with-a-current-weekly-goal: a project cannot adopt the goals convention without the current plan-track skill installed.
tasks.title: Install the skill suite into medtech-intel-QMSR once it has code
tasks.note: New venture repo created 2026-07-28, still empty pending the app import. Run ./install.sh --repo <clone> and add it to the fleet table in README.md. Claimed 2026-07-30 night-shift.

tasks.title: Drift check: installed .claude/skills/ copies vs this repo's source
tasks.note: Two copies of a skill always drift eventually — that risk is why this repo exists. Diff each project's installed copies against skills/, report differences, and open a PR re-installing where they've diverged. Claimed 2026-07-29 night-shift; scoped to report-only (this repo never pushes into project repos, 2026-07-28). Done 2026-07-29 night-shift: reports/2026-07-29-skills-drift.md + scripts/skills_drift.py; fleet is one commit behind (2026-07-28), no in-place edits found.

tasks.justification: Moves projects-with-a-current-weekly-goal: rules that are practiced but unwritten cannot be adopted by a project that only reads the manual.
tasks.title: Audit: conventions practiced but not written down
tasks.note: Several rules were learned in conversation and only partly recorded (e.g. file-first deliverable delivery, plan-file union merges, regenerate-don't-hand-merge). Sweep recent project history for rules being followed that conventions/ doesn't state, and propose additions.

tasks.title: Evaluate which built-in Claude skills are worth adopting into the house suite
tasks.note: Candidates seen in use: /security-review before a traffic push, skill-creator for authoring/evaluating skills properly, fewer-permission-prompts to cut interruptions. Owner call on which become house practice.
